# The query cases the Windows release gate runs (.github/scripts/e2e-cases.sh), by name: a name runs in every language
# that has a case of it. Every one has failed on Windows: a path written with `\`, a command line msys parsed by its own
# rules (`'`, `"`, `*`), the build lock that locked nothing, a path on another drive. The nightly runs every case.
